statements.proposition: This change falls back to standard ILIKE queries when ParadeDB is unavailable, without changing behaviour for existing (non-ParadeDB) setups.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The fallback to ILIKE exists (MultiFieldSearchWithTableAlias), but the non-ParadeDB path is not strictly backward compatible: link-share search no longer matches the hash column, and project search now also matches description and identifier. Impact claim settled by diff reading, no tests run; a reader who counts only the fallback mechanism might say TRUE.
evidence: pkg/db/helpers.go diff: MultiFieldSearchWithTableAlias returns builder.Or of ILIKE conditions when ParadeDB is not installed
pkg/models/link_sharing.go diff: db.ILIKE("hash", search) removed; only db.ILIKE("name", search) remains, and only if search != ""
pkg/models/project.go diff: fallback project search now uses title, description and identifier (previously only l.title ILIKE)
pkg/models/task_search.go diff: task search uses the multi-field helper, equivalent to old title/description ILIKE OR on fallback
